resources.string: I have read and accept the Privacy Policy
To create an account you must accept the Privacy Policy.
A JSON file with all your data (profile, team, requests, transfers, match events and chat messages).

Your account is deleted immediately and cannot be recovered. You leave your team (if you are its only member the team is deleted too; otherwise the admin role passes to the next member), your chat messages are deleted and, in the statistics of past matches, your name becomes \"Removed player\".
Futebol Amador is managed by whoever runs this installation of the platform. For any request about your data, use the contact in the Privacy Policy on the website.

Account: name, e-mail, password (kept only by Firebase Authentication), phone, address (we show only the town), date of birth. Sports profile: position, height and, if you add them, weight, preferred foot, nationality and photo. Activity: team, requests, invitations, transfers, line-ups and match events. Chat messages. Technical: IP address (abuse prevention, not stored) and the notification token, if you allow notifications. Location is only used when you tap \"use my location\" at sign-up, to fill in the address, and only the approximate location.
Why, and on what legal basis

Providing the service (account, teams, matches, leagues, chat, notifications): performance of the contract. Security and abuse prevention: legitimate interest. Statistics of past matches after you delete your account, already without your name: legitimate interest, with anonymisation. No advertising, marketing profiles or third-party analytics.

Other users see your name, position, town, team and statistics. E-mail, phone, address and date of birth are only visible to you and your teammates. Processors: Google Firebase (authentication, chat, notifications; possible transfer to the USA under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses), Cloudinary (images), Cloudflare (anti-bot check on the website) and the hosting provider of the API and database (EU).

While the account exists; when you delete it, your personal data is deleted or anonymised immediately. Accounts that never confirmed the e-mail: 30 days. Unanswered join requests: 90 days. Match invitations: 30 days after the proposed date. Backups: up to 14 days (90 days for chat).

Access and portability: Settings → \"Download my data\". Rectification: your profile. Erasure: Settings → \"Delete Profile\" (asks for your password). Objection and restriction: through the contact above. Complaints: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (www.cnpd.pt). We reply within one month.

Encrypted connections (HTTPS), session encrypted on the phone with a key from the Android Keystore, no backups of app data, access control per team. In case of a data breach with risk to you, we notify the CNPD within 72 hours and, if the risk is high, you directly.
